name: M70 High Precision 3D Printer Resin
verdict: Strip test, centre 15 s (bars 6.0-24.0 s). #1 (6.0 s) barely formed, thin and translucent; #2 (8.3 s) rolled into a tube; #3 (10.5 s) and #4 (12.8 s) formed but let go of the film and curled hard. #5 (15.0 s) holds to the film and lies flat, only its lifted edge curls a little; #6-#8 (17.3-24.0 s) hold and lie flat. Thickness: #1-#3 thinner, constant from #4 on - the light goes only shallow into this resin (high precision). Thickness does not pick the exposure here, the curl does: the coupon pair (with and without anti-aliasing) at 15 s.

tests.txt: Bars 6-24 s. Up to 12.8 s the bars formed but curled and let go of the film; from 15 s they hold and lie flat. Thickness stops growing at 12.8 s - the light goes only shallow into this resin, as a high-precision one should - so the curl, not the thickness, sets the start: 15 s.
Two coupons at 15 s, one with anti-aliasing and one without. We could not tell them apart, side by side or up close.
Two pairs of 14.5 mm lattice cubes at 15 s: with anti-aliasing on top (one mark), without below (two marks). Clean lattices, and no difference between the pairs that we could see.
